title: ai-rulez verify --approvals
description: Output of `ai-rulez verify --approvals --format json`: the re-check of the signed and review-linked approvals that apply to the current content (docs/approvals.md).

online.description: Whether review-linked approvals were checked against the forge.

ref.description: kind:id or kind:domain/id of the approved content.

status.description: unchecked: a review-linked approval that was not looked up because --online was not given.

code.description: The strict-validation code of an invalid approval.

reason.description: Why the approval did not verify, or why it was not checked.
